text:
maya: async standup — canary rollout readiness. Quick template: What I did / Blockers / Today. TL;DR: aiming for 5% canary tomorrow at 18:00Z. Post updates here.

ryan: What I did: wired gateway routing for python-service, validated p95/p99 in staging (p99 ~115ms). Blockers: need prod feature flag created (ff/new-routing). Today: open PR for canary config + test rollback hook.

tasha: What I did: synced with legal — data handling ok for this rollout. Blocker: ops asked to increase audit-log retention for the new routes. Today: approve prod flag once infra confirms retention change.

samir: What I did: smoke-ran 1% canary in staging; saw memory climb on node-group-3. Blocker: investigating OOM-ish churn on ~3/4 pods. Plan: scale node-group-3 by +2 and tweak liveness probe. Will also add saturation alert to PD. Ping @ryan for the logs I pulled.

ryan: sending logs snippet in case useful: ```kubectl -n infra logs gateway-abc | tail -n 50``` — suspicious GC churn ~15:23, repeated allocations from request batcher.

maya: blocker for Dedicated customers: need infra change to allow short-lived burst capacity for reserved GPU pools. Not blocking hosted 5% canary but affects Dedicated acceptance tests. Today: filing INC-2156 to track.

infra-bot: Auto-deploy scheduled: canary-config v3 -> prod at 2026-04-05T17:00Z. React :eyes: to keep or reply here to change.

samir: +1 to postpone to 18:00Z if we need more time to stabilize. Also proposing: automatic cutoff if error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m.

tasha: agree postpone to 18:00Z. I'll update stakeholders and shift the customer comms window.

maya: final checklist (quick):
- feature flag created in prod (ff/new-routing)
- rollout plan doc linked in PR
- rollback tested in staging
- PD alerts configured
- infra ticket filed (INC-2156)
If all thumbs, I flip to 5% at 18:00Z. :thumbsup:

ryan: PR #4389 opened for canary routing config — small change to routing table and flag toggles. cc @maya @samir for review.

samir: reviewing PR now, will approve after one minor comment about probe timeouts.

maya: merge contingent on INC-2156 referenced in PR and a note in the rollout doc with exact rollback command. Also add canary metric to dashboard: inference_latency_p99_by_slice.

tasha: prod comms draft: https://docs.google.com/XXX — please add short notes about Dedicated impact and rollback steps by EOD.

ryan: quick Q — are we keeping old-model fallback in the routing chain during canary? If yes I'll add actuation rule for 1% fallback traffic.

maya: yes, keep fallback path for 24h after the flip. We'll monitor quality/regressions.

samir: last note: I'll run a final smoke loop 30m before the flip and post results here (latency, error rate, memory). If anything looks off we hold.

maya: thanks all — ping here when PR merged and when infra ticket created. Going dark to join the product sync; will check back in ~2h.
